name: Camping 101: Blacksmithing
summary: Dwukk in Razor Hill can teach you a camp craft suited to your blacksmithing skill. A Sharpening Wheel lets nearby fighters hone their weapons.

sections.title: A camp craft
sections.body: Dwukk teaches you to craft a Sharpening Wheel after you show proficiency in blacksmithing. You can set one up at a wilderness camp, where nearby fighters and rogues can hone their weapons. A campfire is needed to start your camp, and cooks can teach you how to make one.

faq.q: Who teaches me to make a Sharpening Wheel?
faq.answer: Dwukk in Razor Hill teaches you to craft a Sharpening Wheel once you show proficiency in blacksmithing.

faq.q: What does the Sharpening Wheel do?
faq.answer: At your camp, nearby fighters and rogues can use a Sharpening Wheel to hone their weapons.

faq.q: Where can I try out my camp?
faq.answer: You need to head into the wilderness to try out your camp; camps should not be set up in the center of town.
Yes. You need a campfire before starting your camp, and cooks can teach you how to make one.

angles.text: As a blacksmith, you can learn from Dwukk to craft a Sharpening Wheel for a wilderness camp.
As a rogue, you can hone your weapons at a nearby Sharpening Wheel when one is set up at camp.
